customer.purpose: Own customer feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the auth context.
customer.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

sessions.purpose: Own sessions feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the auth context.
sessions.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

auth-support.purpose: Provide reusable auth-support assets shared by multiple auth slices.
auth-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one slice and cross-slice reuse is explicit.
auth-support.justification: auth-support centralizes reusable context-local composition that should not duplicate across slices.
auth-support.createdFor: Multi-slice workflows that need shared runtime helpers.
auth-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into slice-local modules.
